title: Partial-range GT BSGS with uniform-challenge success above one half

claims.statement: For the protected full-production fixed-G1 pairing-inversion problem with uniform challenges, the deterministic partial-range algorithm in proof.md returns Q in G2 satisfying e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P with success probability at least 1/2, total work including failed challenges at most 2^144 dense-Fp12 equivalents at C=20,000, peak memory at most 2^140 bytes, preprocessing at most 2^143 equivalents included in total work, and no nonuniform advice. It searches precisely the first 2^254 exponents; the exact success is 2^254/r. This analytic classical accounting control requires exponential memory and makes no practical execution or novelty claim.
